name: Banh tieu
summary: Bánh tiêu is fried wheat dough around mashed steamed mung bean, a crisp golden shell with a lightly sweet filling. Eat it hot, in the hand, while you walk.
origin: Vung Tau, from stalls on ordinary streets and small lanes.
culture: Bánh tiêu is a walking snack, sold from stalls on ordinary streets and in small lanes.
texture: The fried wheat shell is crisp and golden around a filling of mashed steamed mung bean.
taste: The mung-bean filling is lightly sweet.
howToEat: Eat it hot, in the hand, in the morning or as a snack later in the day.
where: Look on Trần Hưng Đạo and in the small lanes.
seoTitle: Banh tieu in Vung Tau — fried dough, mung bean
seoDescription: Bánh tiêu is fried wheat dough with a lightly sweet mung-bean filling, eaten hot from street stalls in Vung Tau. Look on Trần Hưng Đạo.
